identity.statusNote: The /pricing path redirects to a login/manage subdomain (manage.billo.app), so pricing details were sourced from third-party listings rather than the official site directly.

keyLimits.en: One-time credit package covering roughly 1-5 UGC videos over 12 months, per third-party pricing breakdown; base cost is reported around 99 USD per video.

addOns.name: Expedited delivery / enhanced creator selection add-ons, reported to push per-video cost to ~150 USD

cautions.en: The official pricing page was not directly accessible (redirects to a login screen); all pricing figures come from third-party reviews and should be reverified once a public pricing page is confirmed.
Pricing is package/credit-based rather than a flat monthly subscription; per-video cost varies with add-ons like rush delivery.

capabilities.en: Marketplace connecting brands with vetted UGC (user-generated content) creators to produce authentic ad-style videos on demand.
Brief-based creator matching with revision rounds included in each video order.
Bulk credit packages for brands needing recurring volumes of video content for ad campaigns.

limitations.en: No public flat-rate pricing; costs depend on package size and optional add-ons like expedited delivery.
Video turnaround and quality depend on marketplace creator availability rather than an in-house production team.
